advisory.summary: Same synthetic SSRF sink open_conn(url) as TEGRON-PY-SSRF-0001-REACHABLE, but in a build where the vulnerable callable is PRESENT yet no recognized ingress or program root reaches it. Negative shape: installed-but-unreachable (UNKNOWN, never a confident 'safe'). F-B2: 'installed' means vendored first-party source, not environment-resolved (no dependency/environment indexer pre-PLAN-270).

acquisition.notes: First-party Python repro. src/app.py declares the vulnerable sink open_conn as a first-party def (so it resolves to a symbol and is a call-graph node), but the only route handler (health) calls harmless; open_conn is an orphan no ingress/root reaches. The scanner therefore emits an empty ReachPath AND declares no_known_ingress -- UNKNOWN, never 'safe'. The def MUST stay present: a fixture whose 'unreachable' property held because the symbol was absent would be a different case and would not satisfy C3. No target code is executed.

expected_verdict.label: undetermined
expected_verdict.rationale: The vulnerable sink open_conn is present in the build (resolves to exactly one first-party symbol) but no ingress or program root reaches it over the source-lexical call graph, so reachability yields no path and declares no_known_ingress. Under the inv.5 honesty boundary this is UNKNOWN, never a confident not-affected. Verdict correctness is out of scope for PLAN-070.
